identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Add New Polis citizen Welcome Package for resident agents

values.summary: Draft one source-grounded versioned Welcome Package, validate its required sections and safety language offline, obtain exact-head documentation review, and publish without merging.

steps.action: Draft the versioned Welcome Package from current resident-agent, Shepherd, Layer 8, and governed communication source evidence.
Run the issue-owned documentation validator and Markdown/diff hygiene checks.
Obtain independent exact-head documentation review and publish the PR without merging.

invariants: Documentation claims only current governed capabilities
No credentials, private state, or machine-local paths appear
No live Runtime or provider proof is implied
risks: Friendly language could overstate capability or personhood
Static documentation could drift from Runtime policy
Readers could mistake future onboarding automation for delivered behavior
stop_conditions: A claim cannot be grounded in current repository evidence
The document would imply new Runtime behavior
Scope expands beyond the one document and validator
